positive_snippets:
I had an absolutely wonderful stay at this hotel. From the moment I arrived, the staff were warm, attentive, and genuinely committed to ensuring a comfortable experience. The check-in process was smooth and quick, and I was pleasantly surprised by the immaculate cleanliness and thoughtful details in the room.

The ambience of the property is truly inviting — elegant décor, peaceful surroundings, and well-maintained facilities. The bed was exceptionally comfortable, the linens felt premium, and the room had all the amenities one could ask for. Housekeeping was consistent, timely, and discreet.

The food was another highlight. Whether it was the breakfast spread or in-room dining, everything was delicious, fresh, and beautifully presented. The service team deserves special appreciation for their professionalism and hospitality.

What stood out most was the overall atmosphere — calm, refined, and perfect for both leisure and work. I left feeling refreshed and genuinely cared for.

Highly recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a memorable and seamless stay.
It was an amazing stay! The food was very nice, especially the fried rice with Manchurian - that combo was really amazing 😋. And the room service was top-notch too
Nice rooms in decent price with excellent service ... Recommended for happy time
negative_snippets:
My experience with Akriti Hotel was extremely disappointing and unprofessional. I had personally visited the hotel earlier and received confirmation that two rooms could be arranged for wash and change purposes for a family wedding nearby, with payment in cash. However, when I returned to book the rooms, the staff completely denied the prior commitment and showed zero accountability.

When I requested clarification, the response was dismissive and careless. Speaking to the owner, , made the situation worse due to his rude and unprofessional behavior. There was no effort to resolve the issue or honor what was promised.

This level of unreliability and poor hospitality is unacceptable. I strongly advise others to avoid this property, as you may face last-minute surprises that can ruin important plans.

It is not worth of money.
